headline: Board to review AHTF loan funding, a $500,000.00 Bridge Club/Troubled Waters loan payment update, and a $500,000.00 CPC grant application due Nov. 5.
summary: The board will discuss an updated AHTF balance with a new loan funding request, an update on the $500,000.00 Bridge Club / Troubled Waters AHTF loan payments, and the $500,000.00 CPC grant eligibility with an application due Nov. 5. It will also review new vetted funding opportunities from City of Lowell Executive Staff and set the next meeting date.
items: New Business - Updated balance of AHTF with new loan funding request added
New Business - Update of the $500,000.00 Bridge Club / Troubled Waters AHTF loan payments
New Business - Update of the $500,000.00 CPC Grant Eligibility and application due Nov. 5
New Business - Update of new vetted funding opportunities from The City of Lowell Executive Staff
Schedule for next meeting November 18th @ 4:30 in the MRR 2nd Floor City Hall
location: Mayor's Reception Room, 2nd Floor, Lowell City Hall, 375 Merrimack Street, and via Zoom
